description:
This episode of "I’d Like to Know" brings together theological, practical, and even cultural questions — all tied to real concerns from everyday Adventist believers. In this heartfelt episode of “I’d Like to Know”, Pastors Stephen Bohr, and David Salazar respond to thoughtful questions about salvation, ceremonial practices, and the Bible’s view on unclean animals.

0:00 Intro

02:08 – Do we receive the white robe of righteousness at conversion?
Is the white robe removed if stained? Does cleansing happen at death or during the investigative judgment? How does this relate to our names in the Book of Life?

17:40 – Leviticus 11 says not to touch unclean carcasses — does this apply to our pets?
What should we understand about the command regarding animals that go on all fours? Are dogs and cats included in that prohibition after they die?

22:38 – Are common wedding ceremonies biblical, or are they pagan?
Is there a specific wedding format in the Bible? Should Christians wear white gowns, veils, and rings — or is this a tradition we should avoid?

🕊️ Join us for a deep dive into grace, health, and biblical customs. Every question leads to timeless truth.

📅 New episodes every Tuesday at 4 PM PT on SUMtv.

💬 Submit your Bible question in the comments for a future episode to tv@sumtv.org
